palette.$description: Primitive ramps, assembled (Derived): Manus ships Tailwind 3 without its colour palette and declares only semantic variables, so every colour literal it declares (433 declarations, 165 of them translucent) is placed on the ramp of its hue, neutral first. A translucent token is its ramp step at that alpha, so every declared colour sits on a ramp. Hue families: neutral (channels within 8, or saturation under 12%), then red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple and pink by hue angle. Each hue has two views: `<hue>` is a 50 to 950 ramp (up to 11 stops, each the declared colour nearest that lightness) and `<hue>-all` lists every declared colour of the hue, lightest first. The user-selectable accent palettes (blue, green, yellow, pink, orange, purple, black) fold into these ramps; each step's `declaredAs` says which palette or variable holds it.
